name: Ridge
description: Ridge is a website template for roofing and sheet metal companies, with a roof cross-section that explains each layer and its material, a roof cost estimator that turns the roof area, scope and material into a price range and working days, a map of recent jobs across the region and a process from the inspection to the handover. Slate ink, copper flashing and warm paper with condensed Bebas Neue headings give the website a sturdy, craftsman character. Replace the copy, photos, company details, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with a rating, a free quote and an emergency call button
Roof cross-section with the job and material of each layer
Roof cost estimator with area, scope and material, showing a price range and working days
Services with prices per square metre
Map of recent jobs with scope, duration and material
Process from the inspection to the handover with the time of each stage
Service pages with a material table and FAQ with FAQPage structured data
Customer reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
